item.title: Actor Emma Laird On ‘The Bone Temple’, Female Directors And Her Bestie Bill Nighy
item.description: Following her performance as Jimmima in ‘28 Years Later: The Bone Temple’, British Vogue sits down with actor Emma Laird to talk apocalypses, ditching modelling and her next move.

item.title: The Nigella Lawson Renaissance Could Not Have Come At A Better Time
item.description: A super-fan ever since she moved to London as a “bright-eyed and broke” twenty-something, Jessica Burrell argues that Nigella Lawson –recently announced as the new judge on ‘The Great British Bake Off’ – is exactly the right role model for 2026.

item.title: Replacing Meditation With Vagus Nerve Stimulation Improved My Sleep, Digestion And More
item.description: Vagus nerve stimulation appears to be everywhere, framed as both a clinical intervention and a softer lifestyle concept – through everything from wearable tech devices to low-effort nervous system “resets”. The implication is compelling: that the vagus nerve plays a central role in our ability to regulate stress, and that by stimulating it, we can help the body shift into a calmer state – and without needing to silence the mind first.

item.title: When Nothing Else Worked, Barefoot Walking Helped Me Grieve My Closest Friend
item.description: “Like meditation, it forces us to pause, to observe, to absorb earth’s natural magic,” writes Rachel Ament, on the surprising, therapeutic magic of grounding.

item.title: The Ghd Speed Is One Of The Fastest Hair Dryers I’ve Tried
item.description: Ghd Speed review: This hair dryer is designed for serious time-saving. The heated tool offers ultra-fast drying without the damage.

item.title: The 23 Best-Dressed Stars At The 2026 Grammys
item.description: At the Grammys 2026, the big winners included Olivia Dean, Lady Gaga and Bad Bunny. They triumphed on the red carpet, too, wearing Chanel, Matières Fécales and Schiaparelli menswear, respectively. See all of the best-dressed stars from the 2026 Grammy Awards.

item.title: Grammys 2026 Winners List: Bad Bunny, Billie Eilish, Olivia Dean And More
item.description: The Grammy Awards 2026 saw trophies handed out to big winners including Kendrick Lamar and Lady Gaga. Brit artists also represented: Olivia Dean was named Best New Artist, while Lola Young took the trophy for Best Pop Solo Performance for her Gen-Z anthem, “Messy”.

item.title: Harry Styles Perfects The Shirtless Blazer At The 2026 Grammys
item.description: Harry Styles appeared on stage at the 2026 Grammy Awards wearing a blazer from Jonathan Anderson’s Dior with nothing underneath, straight-leg jeans and mint-green ballet flats.
